notes.note: #0.280-294 continue story_125's leader block (labels 'Mebius' carried over). Identical JP kept identical to story_125's #0.284 wording.
Formal 'machitamae' + 'hou ga ii' variant: written older/formal (Rider 1-like).
Addresses Ankh casually ('matte, Ankh'): likely OOO.
Rough variant (n-ee); written as a suggestion to Ankh: 'Shouldn't we hold off'.
#0.296-310: 15 leader variants. 'Shinkou shita ruuto' = the route the Gundam Team advanced along -> 'pushed through'. #0.304 rough (ze), #0.305 polite (mashou), #0.308 rough 'try following'.
Narration (no speaker), past tense like story_125 narration. Epyon referred to as 'him' later per glossary g=m.
#0.2-15: 14 leader copies of 'masaka...'. 'Don't tell me...' chosen over 'No way...' since the party suspects Epyon has turned (confirmed in story_127).
'Gaddess ga hikitsurete' = Gaddess is leading Epyon; 'yatsura' = the heroes/Gundam Team. Gaddess is g=f (Hiling), hence 'She' in #0.6.
Gaddess taunting the Gundam Team: the Virgos alone will be enough to end them (Epyon not even needed).
'Nameyagatte' kept at full force as an angry retort.
#0.14-28: 15 leader variants addressed to Ankh (who spotted the monitor). Voiced from wording: #0.21/#0.24 rough (n-ee/iku zo), #0.25 polite (masu).
Unlabelled speaker; likely Ankh (next row's narration is tagged Ankh). Kept speaker-neutral.
Narration line tagged with Ankh's speaker id; translated as narration.
#0.3-0.8 begin a leader block that continues in story_127 (#0.9-17). #0.3 and #0.4 identical JP -> identical EN.
Question variant: 'Was it the Gundam Team?' Passive kept in second sentence since the destroyer is the referent of the question.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks voiced from wording (labels 'Mebius' carried over in 0642). Uncertain: #0643 'masaka' read as suspicion of Epyon ('Don't tell me...'); 0646#0.1 speaker unlabelled; 0646#0.2 narration tagged Ankh. No new names; Gundam Team, Virgo, Gaddess, Gadessa per glossary.
